summary:
I've built the test-case workbook for Newsletter Signup. It has 36 cases (20 Functional, 16 API) and covers all 3 requirements (100%, nothing uncovered).

- **By category:** 6 Positive, 14 Negative, 10 Corner, 6 Boundary. The boundary cases check emails of 99, 100 and 101 characters.
- **By criticality:** 16 High, 13 Medium, 7 Low.
- **Roles:** the requirements don't mention any, so there's no permission matrix or role tests.
- **Files:** `output/2026-11-18-5db79d/newsletter-signup_TestCases.xlsx` plus TestRail CSVs in the same folder. To import, use Test Cases → Import → CSV with the "Test Case (Text)" template.
- **Top open questions:** what the success message says and whether there's a confirmation email; which email-format rule applies, including non-English addresses; whether duplicate checks ignore letter case and spaces, and whether unsubscribed emails count as duplicates. Also unanswered: whether the API needs a login and what its responses contain, and whether there's rate limiting. I logged assumptions for the first three so those cases can still run.
